description: Adelaide Metro General Transit Feed is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. The General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) defines a common format for public transportation schedules and associated geographic information. GTFS "feeds" allow public transit agencies to publish their transit data and developers to write applications that consume that data in an interoperable way. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are bus, bus stops, maps, public transport, stop. It offers 1 resource(s) in API. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
